notes: Tag ID -> simulated elemental composition, used by the console's analysis panel.
THIS IS A SIMULATION, NOT A MEASUREMENT. The console does not carry a spectrometer.
Each entry is a preset chosen when the arena was prepared, standing in for an
instrument like APXS or PIXL on a real rover (proposal 5.4). The percentages below
are plausible for the named mineral class and are illustrative only -- they are not
assay data and must never be presented as such.
Edited per arena setup, without reflashing the rover: the rover only ever reports a
tag ID, and this mapping lives entirely on the console. Point COMPOSITION_TABLE at
another file to override, or drop one at user://compositions.json.
Keys are the tag EPC in uppercase hex, exactly as the reader reports it.
Percentages are by mass and should total about 100.
The IDs below match the default rocks in tools/fake_rover.py.
